taurajo_centaur_wind.description:
Ruka, quartermaster. I've sent three warbands north this season and had two come back.

The Kolkar are raiding the Northern Barrens road - not the war camp out east, a different clan, and faster. They hit Far Watch Post, where the road bends toward Durotar, and they're gone before the garrison is off the wall.

I can't spare another warband. I can spare you.

Kill their raiders where you find them, and do it where the garrison can see. Half of holding a post is the post believing somebody's coming.
taurajo_centaur_wind.accept_text: South gate, then north up the Gold Road until the Barrens changes its name. Far Watch Post is on the east side of the Northern Barrens, where the road bends toward Durotar. The raiders work the ground round its palisade.
taurajo_centaur_wind.turn_in_text:
Good. Kelsara will have counted from the wall, and she'll write to say so, and that's one letter this month I'll enjoy reading.

Don't put your pack down. I want to know what that post actually looks like.

taurajo_scout_outposts.description:
Outrider Kelsara's reports say Far Watch holds. Her requisitions say she's going through arrows like a siege.

Both of those can't be true, and I have to decide which one to supply.

Go and look at the post itself. Not the raiders - the wall. Count the gaps in it and the faces on it, and come back and tell me what I'm paying for.
taurajo_scout_outposts.accept_text: Far Watch Post again - the east side of the Northern Barrens, where the road bends toward Durotar. Walk right up to the palisade.
taurajo_scout_outposts.turn_in_text:
Holding, but holding thin. Patched in three places and the patches are newer than the wall.

That's what I thought. She gets the arrows, and she gets them today.

taurajo_outriders_warning.description:
The outriders came in overnight, and I don't like what they brought.

The raiders you thinned at Far Watch were a screen. The clan itself is massing at Mor'shan Base Camp, in the north of the Northern Barrens, below the Rampart.

If they take the base camp they cut the Gold Road, and then nothing reaches Ashenvale and nothing comes back from it. The Warsong up there are fighting on what we send them.

Hit the raiders where they're gathering, before they've finished gathering.
taurajo_outriders_warning.accept_text: Mor'shan Base Camp - north up the Gold Road, most of the length of the Northern Barrens, just short of the Rampart. They're massing round it. Their marauders on the Kolkar Plains, east of this town, are the same clan and count the same.
taurajo_outriders_warning.turn_in_text:
Broken up at the base camp. Then the road's open for another month.

I'd promote you if you were mine. Since you're not, take what a warband would have drawn.

taurajo_salvage_wagons.description:
Dresk. Caravan guard. You want to know what I guard? Grain. Three wagons of it left here for Far Watch Post and none of them got there.

The Kolkar raiders hit the wagons and ran them down. They don't even want the grain. They want the post hungry. But a raider's a raider, and a sack is worth carrying, so they'll have taken what they could sling over a saddle.

Get it back off them. Trampled is fine. Trampled grain still makes bread.
taurajo_salvage_wagons.accept_text: North up the Gold Road into the Northern Barrens. The Kolkar raiders round Far Watch Post, on the east side, and round Mor'shan Base Camp are carrying the sacks.
taurajo_salvage_wagons.turn_in_text:
Trampled, split, and one of them's been bled on.

It'll do. Sift it and it's bread. Far Watch eats this week because of you - I'll make sure Kelsara knows whose name to curse less.

taurajo_windhoofs_ledger.title: Bounty: Kolkar Raiders
taurajo_windhoofs_ledger.description:
Grukan. The board. This one's fresh - Sergra put it up herself, and Sergra doesn't post bounties, she posts orders, so you know she's run out of people to order.

Kolkar raiders, in the Northern Barrens. A full count of them, proof on the hoof. They're the ones cutting the road to Far Watch and massing at Mor'shan.

No name on it. No khan, no chieftain. Just a number. That's the kind of bounty you post when you're not trying to win, you're trying not to lose.
taurajo_windhoofs_ledger.accept_text: The Northern Barrens - north up the Gold Road. They raid round Far Watch Post in the east and mass at Mor'shan Base Camp in the north. The marauders and drudges on the Kolkar Plains, east of town, count too.
taurajo_windhoofs_ledger.turn_in_text:
That's the count. I'll mark it paid.

First one off this board in a month. I'm going to leave the nail in, so people can see there used to be something there.

ratchet_thinning_the_grounds.description:
Kala. I hunt for the camp. Walk with me a moment.

The kodo moved south early this year, and I have been finding out why. It is the raptors. The Sunscale on the Raptor Grounds have bred past what the ground can feed, and the lashtails - the young hunters, the bold ones - have started running the herds instead of the strays.

A herd that is run does not graze. A herd that does not graze does not calve. I will not have this camp go hungry in spring for the sake of a raptor's good year.

Thin the lashtails. Not all of them. The Grounds are theirs. Only enough that they remember it.
ratchet_thinning_the_grounds.accept_text: Out the south gate into the Southern Barrens, then south-east, below the Hoodoo Spires. The Raptor Grounds are the red flats there. The lashtails are the ones with the banded tails.
ratchet_thinning_the_grounds.turn_in_text:
That is enough. Leave the rest.

The herds will come back up by the next moon. You will not see it, I think - you have the look of someone going south. But the calves will, and that is who it was for.

taurajo_carvers_materials.accept_text: Off the Kolkar marauders - not the raiders, their horn is too young. The marauders keep to the Kolkar Plains: out the north gate, up past the Crossroads, then east.
